sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Keep I.R.A. facing away from the raid and attack from behind to avoid Flamethrower.
Commit damage efficiently while keeping the tank stable through each stronger round.
Use each respite to recover quickly and prepare for the next round.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 2.
The current Sprint profile explicitly disables the clockwork add waves used in Marathon.
